mentions.name: Nickel
mentions.description: A short-form video platform featuring 5-second clips and videos up to 5 minutes long, inspired by Vine. It supports video previews in messaging apps and serves as a place to share gaming clips without using YouTube.
mentions.audience: Missing Vine and wanting an alternative to YouTube for sharing gaming clips
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a video platform called Nickel. 5-second clips and 5-minute (max) videos.
